rubrics.justification: The morphology assessment is plausible and appropriately cautious (4BB/4BC), with reasonable comments on expansion, ICM, and TE, but it includes some features not reliably inferable from a single static image and lacks confidence limits given image-only assessment.

It integrates age, diagnosis, ovarian response, sperm parameters, endometrium, and prior biochemical pregnancy well, though it overstates some weaker lifestyle and protocol effects and infers normal ovarian reserve without AMH.
The reasoning is structured and mostly internally consistent, and the implantation estimate broadly follows from the stated factors, though some numeric adjustments are somewhat speculative.

Most recommendations are standard, but assisted hatching, ERA after only one biochemical pregnancy, routine progesterone checks at 5dp5dt, and broad PGT-A endorsement in a 33-year-old are not strongly guideline-supported for this scenario.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, but some suggestions are more optional than indicated and would benefit from stronger prioritization.
